primitives.note: Unseen Threat arms Kha'Zix's next basic attack vs. a champion with bonus magic damage + slow; granted by vision loss or by activating R (Void Assault).
Taste Their Fear, Void Spike and Leap each deal a fixed on-cast/on-landing physical damage instance on cooldown.
Taste Their Fear (and Evolved Reaper Claws) deals 2.1x damage if the target is Isolated (no allies nearby); isolation is checked at end of cast for base Q, start of cast for evolved.
Evolved Reaper Claws reduces Q's cooldown by 45% when the target is Isolated.

Void Assault can be cast, then recast for free (once base, twice evolved) within a 12s window that opens 2s after leaving stealth; each cast/recast re-grants Unseen Threat and the movement-speed buff.
R grants invisibility + bonus move speed and always grants Unseen Threat on cast, independent of actual vision state; a natural opener to guarantee the first empowered attack.
Mana costs on Q (20), W (55-75), E (50), R (100) can meaningfully cap casts across a 15s window depending on mana pool/regen.

Each of Q/W/E has a permanently different evolved form (Reaper Claws / Spike Racks / Wings) selectable via R ranks, changing damage-relevant behavior (Q's isolation CDR; W's extra clusters but capped single-target damage).
Void Spike's self-heal (55-135 + 50% AP) only matters for the survival fight, contingent on Kha'Zix being within the explosion radius.

needsBespoke.why: Every damage-relevant mechanic (empowered next-attack, isolation-conditional damage, evolution-swapped forms, free R recast, resource costs) maps onto existing primitives; nothing requires novel logic beyond them.

No — treat the dummy as non-isolated by default since neither source describes the specific 1v1-no-ally simulator scenario

Has an unstated short expiry window like most 'next attack empowered' buffs, limiting stacking with delayed attacks

options: Assume Evolved Reaper Claws (Q) only, maximizing single-target DPS via isolation CDR
Assume all three evolutions are eventually available/chosen per some other priority (e.g. per typical build order) even though only Q meaningfully raises dummy-fight damage

Immediately use the empowered basic attack (Unseen Threat) on the dummy for the bonus magic damage + slow.
Cast Q (Taste Their Fear) on cooldown for isolated physical damage (assuming target counts as Isolated).
Cast E (Leap) to close/re-engage distance and deal its landing AoE damage, buffering Q afterward if needed.
Cast W (Void Spike) on cooldown for its physical damage tick.
Weave basic attacks between every ability cast (cast times are all 0.25s, leaving auto-attack windows).

Recast R as soon as the free-recast window opens (2s after breaking stealth) to re-trigger Unseen Threat for another empowered attack, repeating this loop of R-recast + empowered attack + Q/W/E on cooldown until 15s elapses.
Recast Q/W/E every time each comes off cooldown, prioritizing Q given its short 4s (or ~2.2s evolved-isolated) cooldown for the highest attack-count contribution.
